title: Project Engineer
description:
Company Summary:

Recurrent Energy is a wholly owned subsidiary of Canadian Solar Inc. and is one of the world's largest and most geographically diversified utility-scale solar and energy storage project development, ownership, and O&M platforms. Recurrent Energy is focused on bringing low-cost clean energy and meaningful economic development to communities across the globe.


At Recurrent Energy, we believe in the power of teamwork to create a sustainable future. Join us as we work together toward a cleaner, greener tomorrow.


Position Title: Project Engineer

Department: Engineering & Construction

Reports To: Sr. Manager, Project Engineering

Location: Flexible hybrid model from our offices in São Paulo. In addition, traveling may be required to project sites.


Position Summary:

Recurrent Energy is comprised of an innovative, passionate, and hard-working team that is committed to making a difference and transforming the world with clean electricity. People are what make the company stand out. As a Project Engineer, you demonstrate the perfect combination of technical expertise and project management savvy.


You will lead the development, coordination and review of designs and technical standards for Recurrent Energy’s utility scale solar and BESS projects. At the core, as a Project Engineer you are an expert coordinator, bringing together stakeholders of every level for effective and profitable project deliveries.


Responsibilities:


Design Oversight

  • Develop, coordinate development, and review designs for Recurrent Energy projects (including permitting and construction support, customer care, and sales support).
  • Manage the work of engineering services providers and consultants.
  • Establish, maintain and improve technical specifications for Recurrent Energy facilities and equipment.
  • Provide technical support for interconnection in collaboration with transmission engineering team.
  • Support the performance and LCOE optimization process of Recurrent Energy projects.
  • Complete technical site assessment reviews and pre-design site visits.


Construction Support

  • Lead technical oversight during design and construction phases of the project, including value added engineering consistent with the required project specifications and requirements.
  • Provide engineering and QA/QC support to the project management team during project construction and commissioning.
  • Provide technical direction during startup, testing, PV system commissioning and performance monitoring.


Vendor Management

  • Provide technical support for the review/preparation of client proposals and EPC/equipment RFP packages.
  • Participate in the evaluation and selection of EPC and main equipment suppliers.
  • Participate in the preparation, review, and negotiations of the technical exhibits for project sales, equipment procurement and EPC contracting agreements.
  • Attend factory acceptance tests for HV and electrical equipment.
  • Evaluation of PV products, emerging technologies and best practices in the solar EPC field.


Financial & Organizational Scope

  • Collectively responsible for project budgets of $100 – 500 million
  • Communicate and influence cross-functionally within Recurrent Energy.
  • Responsible for consultant scopes and associated costs.


Reporting Relationships & Interactions

  • Works cross functionally and collaboratively with all departments.
  • Manages consultant work orders to ensure scope, schedule, quality and coordination requirements are met.
  • Interfaces with third-party engineering service providers, and subcontractors.


Abilities

  • Problem solving skills: takes a systematic and proactive approach to solving problems. Actively seeks out issues rather than reacting to them as they come up.
  • Self-development: knows own capabilities, seeks out feedback and responds positively to constructive criticism.
  • Critical thinking: can break a situation down into smaller pieces to identify its key or underlying issues.
  • Flexibility: has the ability to work in a variety of situations, and with various individuals and groups. Understanding and appreciating different and opposing perspectives on an issue and adapting one’s approach to the changes at hand.


Qualifications:

To perform this job successfully, an individual will perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


  • A minimum of a bachelor’s degree in an Engineering or Technical field.
  • 3-5 years of progressive experience with engineering. procurement and construction of utility scale solar PV systems.
  • Extensive knowledge of IEEE and other governing standards for design of solar PV systems.
  • Knowledge of solar and BESS project engineering, procurement, and construction processes.
  • Knowledge of engineering economics and design optimization.
  • Knowledge of project contract terms including PPAs, interconnection agreements and real estate.
  • In depth knowledge of either DC/AC electrical systems, HV equipment, civil design or SAT structural design/calculations for utility scale solar projects.
  • Professional Engineer or equivalent regulatory body license is a plus.
  • Working knowledge of basic computer skills.
  • Travel to project sites when needed.
  • Bilingual with Portuguese and English.



Career Growth:

At Recurrent Energy, we are committed to fostering career growth and development. As a Project Engineer, you will be an individual contributor who must manage complex schedules and meet deadlines, navigate a variety of personalities, and stay on (or under) budgets. Your manager will help you advance your career in a way that suits your goals and strengths.


Recurrent Energy is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE).Qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, or veteran status.

title: Development Engineer
description:
Company Summary

Recurrent Energy is a wholly owned subsidiary of Canadian Solar Inc. and is one of the world's largest and most geographically diversified utility-scale solar and energy storage project development, ownership, and O&M platforms. Recurrent Energy is focused on bringing low-cost clean energy and meaningful economic development to communities across the globe.

Position Title: Civil Development Engineer

Department: Engineering, Procurement, & Construction

Reports To: Engineering Manager LATAM

Location: Flexible hybrid model from our offices in São Paulo. In addition, traveling may be required to project sites.



Position Summary

The Development Engineer supports the Development Engineering Manager with projects located across America. This position manages the conceptual design of Recurrent Energy’s utility scale photovoltaic (PV) power plants and battery energy storage system (BESS) facilities. This role is involved from early-stage site evaluation and diligence through contractor hand-off.


Responsibilities

  • Manage the conceptual design of a portfolio of PV and BESS projects with the direction of the engineering manager
  • Proactively plan and manage the workload of drafting consultants and staff
  • Prepare conceptual PV and BESS design layouts and single line drawings
  • Perform PV Plant design optimization based on site-specific environmental factors and constraints
  • Perform site diligence and preliminary design workstreams to ensure project-specific risks are mitigated
  • Create design specifications and coordinate design handoff to the performance and cost estimating teams
  • Manage the evolving project Site Constraints Plan from early site diligence through EPC RFP, including a detailed knowledge of all plottable title issues
  • Execute site visits to assess land characteristics and identify prioritization of diligence
  • Support the procurement of land diligence studies (e.g. geotech, hydro, surveying)
  • Support the permitting and real estate teams with analysis and exhibits
  • Perform civil studies (e.g. hydrological, earthworks, SWPPP)


Financial & Organizational Scope

  • Manages consultant work orders to ensure scope, schedule, quality, and coordination requirements are met.


Reporting Relationships & Interactions

  • Reports to Manager, Engineering
  • Works cross functionally and collaboratively with all departments



Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Expert skills managing AutoCAD relating to construction drawings:
  • multiple evolving survey and environmental x’ref files
  • state plane coordinate systems, grid vs ground coordinates
  • model vs paper-space, layer & line type management, version & quality control
  • Experience interpreting survey and construction drawings
  • Strong knowledge of Excel
  • Experience using Google Earth to investigate project sites
  • Understanding of land development including civil site issues, hydrology, easements and utility routing
  • In-depth engineering experience with construction drawings for land development and/or infrastructure projects
  • Excellent organizational and planning skills with ability to prioritize competing deadlines and a portfolio of projects
  • Strong verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to summarize complex issues and opportunities.
  • Detail-oriented with a strong sense of personal responsibility for work products and team success.
  • Extensive on-boarding, training, and guidance will be provided.
  • Experience reviewing construction cost estimates and schedules is a plus
  • Experience with HEC-RAS and ACAD Civil 3D are a plus.


Requirements

  • 4-year Engineering degree from an accredited educational institution.
  • B.S.in Civil (preferred), Electrical or Mechanical Engineering
  • EIT certification a plus
  • 2+ years of engineering experience with land development and/or infrastructure project design
  • Prior experience in the renewable energy industry preferred but not required.
  • Must be bilingual in Portuguese and English.


Recurrent Energy is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE). Qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, or veteran status.

Todos os dias, buscamos fornecer soluções para alguns dos maiores desafios do mundo - como educação, saúde, energia, água, transporte, habitação e saneamento.


Odebrecht & Inclusão de Pessoas com Deficiência:

Acreditamos que a pluralidade e o conhecimento técnico potencializam a nossa força, aprimoram as nossas entregas e impactam nos resultados.

Para a Odebrecht, a inclusão de Pessoas com Deficiência no ambiente empresarial presume uma postura ativa pela garantia de direitos humanos, com respeito e valorização das diferenças em todas as suas dimensões, reconhecendo também a multiplicidade humana, em todas as suas formas, como fator de inovação, produtividade e performance.

Empresarial pautada em valores humanistas e que favorece a colaboração e a criatividade,

Almejamos construir um ambiente mais inclusivo e acolhedor para pessoas com deficiência, proporcionando condições equânimes para todos. Para tanto, fomentar a representação de pessoas com deficiência na empresa é um dever compartilhado por todas as nossas lideranças nas diversas operações da companhia.

O quadro de Integrantes da Odebrecht é composto por profissionais de diferentes regiões, gerações, graus de escolaridade e áreas de atuação. Sendo assim, pessoas com deficiência de todo o país podem se candidatar neste banco de talentos.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Role Summary

The Senior Backend Engineer is a crucial position within Vingcard | ASSA ABLOY, primarily responsible for designing, developing and maintaining robust backend solutions that power our innovative access control systems for hotels and adjacent markets. The role demands a deep understanding of backend technologies, including Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Java, and Kotlin. The candidate will work in a dynamic, cross-functional team to deliver high-quality software that enhances the functionality and performance of our products.


  • Job Location: Brasilia, Brazil

KEY Responsibilities

  • Design, develop and maintain backend applications using Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Java, and Kotlin.
  • Collaborate with frontend developers to integrate user-facing elements using server-side logic.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code.
  • Contribute to all phases of the development lifecycle, from design to deployment.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize backend systems.
  • Ensure high performance and responsiveness of the application.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of current backend technologies and best practices.
  • Participate in code reviews, providing feedback and suggestions for improvement.
  • Provide technical leadership and guidance to junior developers, helping them navigate technical challenges and grow in their careers.
  • Ensure adherence to best practices in software engineering, including code quality, testing, and documentation.


Responsibilities And Authorities

  • Authority to make technical decisions related to software architecture and design.
  • Access to all necessary information and tools to perform role effectively.
  • Responsibility for delivering high-quality software solutions on time and within budget.
  • Authority to mentor and provide career development support to junior developers.
  • Reporting to the R&D Manager for project assignments and career development.


Internal and External Contacts/Customers

  • Internal: Work closely with other software developers, QA engineers, product managers, and designers.
  • External: Interact with external stakeholders during product demos or user feedback sessions.


Skills

Key competencies, Relevant Knowledge, skills and competEncies

  • Proficient in Java, Kotlin, Spring Boot, and Spring MVC.
  • Strong understanding of RESTful APIs and web services.
  • Experience with observability technologies (e.g. Datadog).
  • Experience with Git versioning systems.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Proactive, self-motivated, and able to manage time effectively.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.
  • 6+ years of professional experience in backend development.
  • Proven experience with Java, Kotlin, Spring Boot, and Spring MVC.
  • Familiarity with Git versioning systems.


Languages

  • Proficiency in English for listening, reading and writing. Intermediate speaking skills in English. Proficiency in Brazilian Portuguese.


Computer Skills

  • Proficiency in software development tools, version control systems (e.g., Git), and Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment pipelines.
  • Proficiency in Java/Kotlin.
  • Deep knowledge of Spring MVC and/or Spring Boot.
  • Proficiency in interacting with relational databases.
  • Working knowledge of distributed architectures and messaging systems (RabbitMQ, AMQP, etc).
  • Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, Kubernetes, etc).


Experience

  • Software Engineer, Backend Engineer or similar position.
  • Minimum 6 years of experience.


Personal qualities

  • Strong leadership and mentorship skills.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Proactive and self-motivated, with a drive to take initiative and lead projects.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team.
  • Continuous improvement mindset, with a commitment to staying up to date with the latest industry trends and technologies.
  • Adaptable and eager to learn new technologies and practices.
  • Detail-oriented with a focus on code quality and best practices.


Expected outcome and deliverables -(For the role, on a 3-5 years horizon)

Over the next 3-5 years, the Senior Backend Engineer will contribute significantly to the development and optimization of our backend systems, ensuring they are robust, scalable, and efficient. The role will play a key part in enhancing the functionality of our access control solutions, delivering high-quality software that meets the needs of our customers and stays ahead of industry trends, including launching new products. The individual in this position will have the opportunity to grow professionally, acquiring new skills and taking on additional responsibilities as part of a dynamic and innovative team.


Vingcard Athos Team

The Vingcard Athos team, based in Brasília, Brazil, specializes in developing innovative solutions for the Build-to-Rent market, catering to both long and short-term rentals of furnished apartments. As a small and dynamic team, we manage the entire solution, including IoT devices, backend, frontend, and mobile applications.


We operate on a hybrid work model, with three days in the office and two days working from home. While our primary language of communication is Portuguese, all our code and documentation are in English, and meetings involving other teams are conducted in English.

Our team is an integral part of the Vingcard Research & Development organization headquartered in Sweden. We are thrilled to have you join us!


CONTRACT DETAILS

  • You will be a registered employee (CLT) of ASSA ABLOY GLOBAL SOLUTIONS IMPORTACAO EXPORTACAO DE EQUIPAMENTOS ELETRONICOS LTDA.
  • Benefits include Vale Refeição.
  • Benefits include health insurance (plano de saúde) for you, your spouse and your children at no additional cost.

Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 61,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.


As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.


As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

title: General Foreman
description:

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia


Who We are?

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises


In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.


ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision, laying the groundwork for long-term success.


Why Join Us?

As a General Foreman , you’ll lead multiple structural work zones, from formwork and concrete to steel and blockwork. You’ll manage a team of Senior Foremen, ensuring all structural activities are planned, resourced, executed, and handed over to the highest technical and safety standards. Your role is critical to coordinating construction efforts, maintaining productivity, and upholding ALEC’s commitment to quality and environmental compliance.


About Your Team

You’ll report to the Section Manager and lead teams of Senior Foremen, Foremen, and labour across various structural disciplines. You’ll work closely with planning, procurement, safety, and QA/QC teams to ensure seamless execution across all phases of work.


Your Role

As a General Foreman, you will:

  • Lead and support Foremen in managing labour and tradesmen across all structural work fronts.
  • Interpret structural drawings and ensure accurate site setup and execution.
  • Plan resources effectively and manage site access, logistics, and emergency readiness.
  • Ensure the timely procurement and correct usage of construction materials and plant.
  • Enforce ALEC’s safety policies, ensuring work is carried out using the proper PPE and safety procedures.
  • Manage heavy equipment and ensure only qualified operators handle machinery.
  • Coordinate across structural teams including carpentry, steel, rebar, blockwork, and concrete.
  • Drive productivity initiatives, ensuring teams work at optimal efficiency.
  • Lead by example, coach site teams, and identify upskilling needs for unskilled labour.
  • Ensure compliance with ISO standards, carry out quality audits, and implement corrective actions.
  • Support environmental management before, during, and after construction phases.
  • Oversee the structural handover process with complete documentation and quality verification.


What We’re Looking For

  • Experience : 10+ years in construction with at least 2 years as a Senior Foreman, specifically in structural works.
  • Certifications : First Aider qualification is required.
  • Technical Knowledge : Strong understanding of structural works including formwork, blockwork, rebar, and carpentry.
  • Leadership : Proven ability to manage large, multi-disciplinary site teams and interface with support functions.
  • Planning & Coordination : Skilled in short-term planning, resource control, and progress tracking.
  • Communication : Effective communicator who builds trust across teams and levels.
  • Safety & Quality : Committed to site safety and consistent delivery to quality standards.


What We Offer

· The chance to contribute to some of UAE most iconic projects.

· A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.

· Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.


Ready to plan the path to project success?

If you’re inspired by what you’ve read and believe you’re the right fit, we’d love to hear from you.

Join ALEC and play a pivotal role in shaping a high-performing team that drives our success.


Apply today and be part of something excellent!

  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Who we are!

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises


In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.


ALEMCO provides integrated MEP and facilities services that power some of the region’s most ambitious developments. From electrical systems to long-term maintenance, we focus on technical reliability and sustainable performance - supported by an inclusive and skilled team with a passion for engineering excellence.


Why Join Us?

As a Commissioning Engineer, you’ll lead the commissioning of Building Management Systems (BMS) across key project sections. From planning resources to optimizing system performance, you’ll play a crucial role in ensuring high-quality installations and efficient site execution.


At ALEMCO, we’re about more than just building iconic structures - we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner to some of the region’s most ambitious projects, we value innovation, operational excellence, and our people. Join us to deliver Project Planning and Controls initiatives that directly shape our business success, from sourcing candidates to enhancing candidate experiences.


Your Role

  • Conduct all BMS commissioning phases: Pre-functional, Functional, and Integrated Systems Testing
  • Perform software/hardware integration with third-party systems
  • Troubleshoot and resolve system defects, supporting other trades and contractors
  • Develop, test, and commission BMS control programs based on detailed Sequences of Operation
  • Oversee Site Acceptance Tests and demonstrate systems to consultants and clients

  • Total package of salary, UAE Employment Visa, Medical Insurance & Annual ticket allowance.
  • The chance to contribute to some of the UAE's most iconic projects.
  • A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.


Ready to Lead?

Apply today and be part of something extraordinary.

description:
No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

title: LÍDER CENTRO DE OPERAÇÕES AGROINDUSTRIAIS (COA)
description:
Que desafio temos para você?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Líder Centro de Operações Agroindustriais para atuar no nosso time do COA.



Quais as responsabilidades?

- Realizar o monitoramento e análise contínua dos indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) para identificar tendências e propor melhorias;

- Coordenar reuniões semanais para revisão de metas, resultados e alinhamento de estratégias com equipe de analistas;

- Elaborar planos de ação para problemas recorrentes e monitorar a execução das soluções implementadas, garantindo a efetividade;

- Propor e implementar inovações tecnológicas ou operacionais para otimizar processos e melhorar a performance do COA;

- Supervisionar a integração entre os turnos, garantindo a continuidade e alinhamento das operações;

- Coordenar auditorias internas para assegurar o cumprimento dos processos e identificar pontos de melhoria;

- Aplicar feedbacks periódicos nos liderados e alinhar expectativas para promover o desenvolvimento contínuo das competências;

- Acompanhar relatórios gerenciais, destacando principais resultados, riscos e ações recomendadas;

- Monitorar e validar dados operacionais enviados para outros setores, assegurando precisão e confiabilidade das informações;

- Ser ponto de apoio no contato entre analistas do COA e áreas estratégicas como: manutenção, qualidade, CTT e planejamento;

- Participar de reuniões com clientes internos para discutir estratégias, melhorias e resultados operacionais;

- Planejar e coordenar treinamentos técnicos e de gestão para os demais colaboradores;

- Identificar gargalos e propor soluções inovadoras para aumentar a eficiência e reduzir custos operacionais.



Quais os requisitos?

Ensino Superior Completo em Logística, Engenharias, Administração ou correlatas;

Vivência na liderança de pessoas;

Pacote office avançado;

Domínio em Sistemas logísticos e ERPs agrícolas (LogTrac, SGPA, Simple Farm, Gatec, SAP, PIMS;

Disponibilidade para turnos;

Residir em Olímpia, Severínia, Cajobi ou Baguaçu/SP.


Qual localidade?

Olímpia/SP.


O que buscamos num profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.


Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.


Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

title: Vaga Afirmativa para Pessoas com Deficiência - Piên/PR
description:
No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.


Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então inscreva-se nesta oportunidade!


Esta vaga é exclusiva para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD) e contempla posições em diversas áreas da unidade de Piên/PR .

QUEM SOMOS

A Binswanger é uma organização internacional de consultoria imobiliária com mais de 80 anos de tradição. Criada nos Estados Unidos em 1931, a companhia assiste a clientes corporativos em mais de 100 países, nos cinco continentes.

Durante os anos 1990, a consultoria iniciou um programa de expansão internacional, formando alianças estratégicas com organizações imobiliárias em todo o mundo, período em que se estabeleceu também no Brasil, maior mercado imobiliário da América Latina.

Fundada em 1997, a Binswanger Brazil nasceu como escritório regional da rede, e em pouco mais de duas décadas se consolidou como uma das principais fornecedoras de serviços imobiliários para o mercado corporativo brasileiro.

Com sede em São Paulo, a companhia conta atualmente com uma das melhores estruturas imobiliárias em operação no país e oferece assistência de alcance global para todo o território nacional em um balcão único para clientes em diversos setores da economia.

Mais do que atender às necessidades de clientes, a Binswanger Brazil oferece linha completa de soluções imobiliárias e projetos personalizados para atender a todas as etapas dos processos imobiliários de seus parceiros de negócio.

Em 2023 realizamos o que foi um marco significativo para o setor imobiliário, anunciamos a fusão entre a Binswanger Brazil e a SDS Properties. Nossa decisão, motivada pela oportunidade de combinarmos tecnologia, dados, relacionamentos e expertise de equipes altamente referenciadas, buscou potencializar ferramentas, inteligência de mercado, capacidade de inovação e consequentemente apresentar aos nossos clientes o mais alto nível de atendimento em Real Estate do país.

title: Especialista em IA e Business Intelligence
description:
Você é movido por dados, inovação e inteligência artificial?

Se você curte transformar informação em estratégia, desenhar soluções inteligentes e gerar impacto real nos resultados do negócio, essa vaga pode ser para você!

Venha fazer parte do time de UPXers e contribua com a nossa missão de tornar a internet um ambiente mais seguro para empresas e pessoas.

Como Especialista em IA e Business Intelligence , sua missão será liderar iniciativas que ampliem a eficiência do canal de vendas em cibersegurança por meio de automações, modelos preditivos e dashboards estratégicos — fornecendo à liderança insights precisos e acionáveis que impulsionem receita, performance e crescimento.

O desafio envolve combinar visão analítica, domínio técnico e mentalidade experimental para desenvolver soluções escaláveis e com alto impacto, sempre com uma abordagem data-driven, colaborativa e voltada a resultados.


Responsabilidades:


  • Selecionar tecnologias (LLMs, pipelines de dados, Power BI, Looker Studio) e integrá-las às plataformas de marketing, comunicação, vendas e processos de gestão estratégica;
  • Desenvolver frameworks analíticos que priorizem oportunidades de mercado, melhorem o score de leads e apoiem decisões de pricing e go-to-market;
  • Suportar os times com análise de dados, interpretando métricas e apresentando insights que orientem ações de marketing, comunicação e vendas;
  • Transformar processos manuais em fluxos autônomos de coleta, enriquecimento e ativação de dados — do first touch ao churn prevention;
  • Traduzir métricas em storytelling executivo, capacitar times internos e institucionalizar governança e qualidade dos dados;
  • Monitorar o desempenho de modelos e automações, ajustando prompts, parâmetros e consumo de recursos para garantir qualidade, velocidade e custo-benefício.


Requisitos e Perfil:


  • Graduação concluída há pelo menos 2 anos em Engenharia de Dados, Engenharia de TI, Engenharia de Computação ou Ciência de Dados;
  • Conhecimento em SQL, Python e fundamentos de machine learning;
  • Experiência comprovada em Power BI ou Looker Studio (modelagem, DAX/LookML, publicação);
  • Inglês técnico;
  • Interesse por cybersecurity.


Diferenciais:


  • Projetos de IA em produção - documentação do problema, stack utilizada e impacto gerado;
  • Projetos com LLMs, LangChain, RAG ou chatbots;
  • Certificações PL-300 (Power BI Data Analyst), DP-100 (Azure Machine Learning Engineer) ou Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer;
  • Vivência com dados de segurança da informação ou SaaS B2B.
  • Experiência com MLOps, incluindo CI/CD de modelos e monitoramento de drift.


Sobre a UPX:


Com mais de 22 anos de atuação, a UPX é referência em cibersegurança e performance digital, protegendo ambientes críticos com atuação 24x7.

Especialistas em mitigação de ataques DDoS, prevenção de incidentes e entrega de conteúdo com alta performance, atendemos grandes players dos setores financeiro, bancário, operadoras e ISPs — no Brasil e nos EUA.

Contamos com unidades em Campinas (SP) e Miami (EUA), além de uma estrutura robusta com times técnicos de elite em Segurança da Informação, Engenharia de Redes, SOC, NOC e Scrubbing Centers.

Na UPX, trabalhamos todos os dias para tornar a internet mais segura, confiável e eficiente para empresas e pessoas.

title: Warehouse Procurement Manager
description:
ABOUT SHEIN


SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle e-retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on demand production methodology, for a smarter, future-ready industry. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has more than 16,000 employees operating from offices around the world, and continues to expand operations globally. Join SHEIN and be the future!



Requirements


  • Sourcing & Vendor Management: Identify, evaluate, and negotiate with suppliers and vendors to secure the best prices, quality, and delivery terms. Develop and maintain strong relationships with key suppliers, ensuring reliability and alignment with our brand values.
  • Purchasing Strategy: Develop and implement procurement strategies that drive cost savings, quality improvements, and operational efficiency. Analyze market trends and supplier performance to make informed procurement decisions.
  • Inventory management: Collaborate with inventory management teams to ensure optimal stock levels and timely replenishment of products. Monitor inventory turnover rates and implement strategies to minimize excess stock and reduce carrying costs.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with production, quality, engineering, and quality teams to ensure that procurement aligns with product development and promotional strategies. Participate in product development meetings to provide insights on material sourcing and cost implications.
  • Sustainability Initiatives: Champion sustainable sourcing practices and collaborate with suppliers to promote environmentally friendly materials and processes. Monitor compliance with ethical sourcing standards and regulations.
  • Budget Management: Prepare and manage the procurement budget, ensuring alignment with financial goals and targets. Track and report on savings and procurement performance metrics.


Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Fashion Merchandising, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in procurement within the fashion retail industry.


Preferred Skills


  • Being familiar with normal logistic packing material and service related to warehouse running.
  • Strong negotiation skills and experience with contract management.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Proven track record of developing and executing successful procurement strategies.
  • Knowledge of sustainable and ethical sourcing practices.
  • Proficiency in procurement software and Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Fluent English.



CAREERS AT SHEIN


We Commit to Inclusion

At SHEIN, we believe that diversity is the force that drives innovation. We are committed to creating an environment where all voices are heard, valued and respected. All our vacancies are inclusive for people with disabilities, women, black people, LGBTQIAPN+ community and all types of diversity.

We Empower Talents with Diverse Careers

At SHEIN, we empower talent to excel with regular opportunities to elevate their career in their respective fields. As a dynamic business, we support internal mobility, diverse career pathways and recognition of success and contribution in a variety of meaningful ways.

We Engage with Global Cultures

SHEIN has over 20 offices worldwide , providing talent with many opportunities to collaborate with colleagues around the world. Perspective sharing and leveraging cultural differences, is one of our core strenghts as we work on many exciting projects and draw insights from industry-leading experience.

title: Corretor de imóveis
description:
Resumo do Cargo

O Corretor de Imóveis parceiro da Apolar Jardim Botânico é um profissional dinâmico e proativo, responsável pela comercialização de imóveis prontos (usados) e lançamentos em Curitiba e Região Metropolitana.

Como ter sucesso no cargo: O sucesso nesta função é impulsionado pela capacidade de entender e antecipar as necessidades dos clientes, oferecendo soluções imobiliárias que geram valor. Isso inclui uma gestão eficiente de leads de diversas fontes, um uso exemplar das ferramentas tecnológicas, e uma participação ativa na angariação de novos imóveis para a carteira. Profissionais que se destacam são aqueles que cultivam relações de confiança, dominam as técnicas de negociação, e mantêm-se atualizados sobre o mercado imobiliário e as condições de financiamento. A colaboração com a equipe e o alinhamento com os objetivos da franquia são diferenciais para alcançar o sucesso.

Responsabilidades
  • Angariar Imóveis: Identificar e angariar ativamente imóveis (usados e lançamentos) na região de Curitiba e Região Metropolitana, expandindo o portfólio da franquia e visando atingir a meta de 100 imóveis em carteira.
  • Gestão de Leads: Gerenciar e qualificar leads provenientes de diversas fontes (portais de anúncio, anúncios patrocinados, portal da Rede Apolar, LAIS), realizando o primeiro contato, acompanhamento e nutrição para convertê-los em clientes qualificados.
  • Uso de CRM: Determinar e desenvolver requisitos de usuários para sistemas em produção (Apolar Sales), garantindo o preenchimento completo e organizado de todas as informações de clientes, imóveis e interações, otimizando o fluxo de trabalho.
  • Atendimento ao Cliente: Realizar atendimento consultivo e personalizado, compreendendo a real necessidade do cliente, apresentando as opções de imóveis mais adequadas e conduzindo visitas de forma eficaz.
  • Negociação e Fechamento: Conduzir processos de negociação de compra e venda, elaboração de propostas e acompanhamento de contratos, garantindo a segurança e transparência em todas as etapas da transação.
  • Colaboração com a Equipe: Colaborar ativamente com a equipe de corretores, gerência e franqueados parceiros, compartilhando informações de mercado, estratégias e melhores práticas para otimização dos resultados coletivos.
  • Avaliação de Imóveis: Colaborar no processo de avaliação de imóveis quando solicitado, utilizando o conhecimento de mercado e, se certificado, o registro no CNAI.
  • Conhecimento de Mercado: Manter-se atualizado/a sobre as tendências do mercado imobiliário de Curitiba, novas legislações, condições de financiamento e o perfil de cada bairro para oferecer um serviço consultivo de excelência.


Qualificações
  • Formação: Ensino Médio completo. Curso superior, é um diferencial, mas não obrigatório.
  • Registro Profissional: Possuir registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Corretores de Imóveis (CRECI).
  • Experiência: Experiência prévia comprovada na comercialização de imóveis, com preferência para atuação em imóveis usados e/ou lançamentos.
  • Competências de Comunicação: Excelentes competências de comunicação oral e escrita, com clareza, persuasão e habilidade para se comunicar por telefone e WhatsApp.
  • Habilidade Tecnológica: Familiaridade e disposição para utilizar ferramentas de CRM (Apolar Sales) e outras tecnologias para gestão de leads, acompanhamento de processos e organização de informações.
  • Proatividade e Resiliência: Capacidade de agir com proatividade na busca por resultados e na angariação de imóveis, além de resiliência para lidar com objeções e desafios do mercado.
  • Orientação para o Cliente: Forte orientação para o cliente, com foco em entender suas necessidades, construir relacionamentos de confiança e proporcionar uma experiência de compra positiva.
  • Organização: Boa capacidade de organização e atenção aos detalhes para manter registros precisos e acompanhar múltiplos processos simultaneamente.
  • Infraestrutura: Possuir carro, notebook, acesso à internet fora do escritório e celular para desempenho das atividades.

Para se candidatar entrar em contato através do e-mail: ou através do celular (WhatsApp) .

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls , em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

title: Talent Pool - Persons with Disabilities (PcD)
description:
About Revolut


People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 60+ million customers get more from their money every day.

People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


Diversity is how we build better

Diversity at Revolut drives better ideas, bolder thinking, and a more inclusive future. We’re committed to increasing representation, especially for people with disabilities who remain underrepresented in tech. That means removing barriers, opening doors, and creating access to opportunity so everyone can contribute, grow, and shape what's next in finance.


Roles we commonly hire for in Brazil


  • Business Analyst
  • Data Analyst
  • Data Scientist
  • Designer
  • Finance Analyst
  • FinCrime Analyst
  • Operations Manager
  • Product Manager
  • Recruiter
  • Software Engineer
  • Support Specialist


This is a dedicated talent track to support the inclusion of professionals with disabilities.

We move fast and we move together. Real innovation starts with representation, and we’re building a team where different abilities and perspectives are welcomed and valued.


If you apply through this channel, our Talent Acquisition team will review your profile with care. When we find a potential fit with an open role, we’ll reach out to connect you with the next steps in our hiring process.


Who can apply through this channel?

We welcome professionals with disabilities to apply through this channel or any other open roles on our careers page. This is a proactive way for us to discover diverse talent. If your profile matches an open position, our team will reach out to guide you through the next steps in the hiring process.


Can I apply if I don’t identify as a person with a disability?

This channel is specifically designed to connect with talented professionals with disabilities who want to grow their careers with Revolut. If this doesn’t describe you, please check out the range of opportunities on our careers page .


Why is Revolut breaking barriers to hire persons with disabilities in Brazil?

Our Revoluters are our priority. That’s why in 2021 we launched our D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive everyday. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.


Does applying here mean I’m automatically part of the recruitment process?

When you apply through this platform, our team will carefully review every profile. If your skills and experience align with a current opportunity, we’ll reach out to invite you to the next stage of our hiring process.


What if I'm not based in São Paulo? Can I still apply?

Yes. Revolut is a remote-first company that hires talent across Brazil and beyond. Our recruitment and onboarding are designed to be fully remote, and we embrace flexible work arrangements tailored to the role and business needs.


What you’ll need

  • Fluency in English
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Great problem-solving skills
  • Experience in a fast-paced working environment
  • The ability to communicate confidently, clearly, and accurately to all levels
  • A confident, self-starter attitude
  • A solid sense of ownership and ability to work independently
  • High attention to detail


Nice to have

  • Fluency in another language
  • Practical knowledge of Google Suite


Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles:

  • Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.


We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

I confirm I have disclosed, if applicable, any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn, or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed.

description:
JOB SUMMARY

Responsible for designing and implementing robust data pipelines. Must maintain high data quality and security in cloud environments, automating tasks with Python and Bash scripting, and continuously research new technologies to enhance scalability. This role focuses on the development and implementation of data engineering solutions that enhance data warehousing capabilities and maintain legacy and new systems.


DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design and implement data pipelines to move and transform data from various sources into cloud-based data warehouses.
  • Develop and maintain ETL processes using tools such as Fivetran, Matillion, SSIS, SSAS, SSRSand Snowflake Dataflow on AWS.
  • Optimize data storage and retrieval by designing and implementing data partitioning, indexing, and compression strategies.
  • Build and maintain data processing infrastructure on cloud platforms such as AWS.
  • Collaborate with business and analysts to ensure data quality, accuracy, and availability for analysis and reporting.
  • Manage and lead Complex System Design, Integration and Development.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot data pipelines and infrastructure to ensure high availability and performance.

  • Automate data processing tasks using scripting languages such as Python or Bash
  • Research and evaluate new technologies and tools to improve data processing efficiency and scalability.
  • Mentor and train junior data engineers and provide technical guidance to cross-functional teams.
  • Perform other job-related functions as assigned.



QUALIFICATIONS

DEGREE TYPE:

Bachelor's Degree

FIELD(S) OF STUDY:

Computer Science, Engineering or related field


EXPERIENCE

  • Minimum of 4 years’ experience developing, validating, and implementing data warehouses, data systems or cloud-based data solutions.
  • Experience in data engineering with a focus on data warehousing and legacy systems.
  • Experience with multiple data modeling approaches, SQL, and scripting programming languages like Python and PowerShell.


COMPETENCIES/SKILLS

  • Good understanding of OLAP Cubes, Dimensional model.
  • Ability to lead and coach team members.
  • Strong communication skills and stakeholder engagement abilities; driving results through innovation, process improvement and creativity.
  • Able to prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure, fast-paced environment.

title: Investment Banking | Intern Position (São Paulo)
description:
Euro Latina Finance

Established in early 2010 by the former Global Head of M&A at Groupe Casino (1998 - 2010), Euro Latina Finance is a French truly independent financial advisory firm specialized in cross-border transactions between Europe and Latin America.


With fully operational regional offices and local teams in Paris, São Paulo, and Bogotá, Euro Latina Finance provides tailor-made M&A and strategic advice to a portfolio of international blue-chip clients. We specialize in cross-border M&A transactions between Europe/US and Latin America ranging from US$200mm – US$1bn+, across a wide array of sectors.


Since its inception, Euro Latina Finance has advised 28 successful transactions on a total of c. 60 M&A projects, including some of the most complex, transformational, and landmark cross-border deals into/from Latin America such as the acquisition of Walmart Brasil by Advent (US/Brazil), the restructuring of Vale New Caledonia (France/Brazil) or the advisory of French industrial laundry group Elis’ on its build-up strategy in LatAm (8 transactions of all sizes advised over 8 years).


Description of the Position:


The Location : São Paulo office located in Itaim Bibi

The Role : M&A Intern


The Intern will be involved in the origination and execution of mergers and acquisitions transactions, including the following tasks: preparation of internal and client presentations (pitches, company profiles, teasers, CIM,…), participation in financial and valuation analysis, participation in meetings or calls with international clients along with the senior team from Euro Latina Finance.


Who are we looking for?

Candidates motivated to work in a dynamic, challenging, multicultural and fast-paced professional environment, holding sharp analytical skills and able to manage various transactions simultaneously.

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the team and different clients across the globe, capable of fostering strong networking, contributing to a highly valued positive culture
  • Diligent and intellectually curious with a strong work ethic and a drive to succeed
  • Rigorous, hard-working, highly motivated, and skilled team-player who can demonstrate analytical skills and engagement to the team and to our clients


Qualifications

  • Full availability to work in our São Paulo office (Itaim Bibi), as this is a 100% on-site position
  • High academic credentials from a leading business and/or engineering school and/or top-tier university
  • Solid background in finance and accounting, exceptional sense of rigor and attention to details and ability to work efficiently under time pressure
  • Previous experience in an IB or PE firm is a preferred qualification
  • Fluency (writing, reading, and speaking) in Portuguese and English (French and/or Spanish would be highly valued)
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Superior level of command of MS-Office Tools, namely Excel and PowerPoint
  • Expected graduation in Jul/26, Dez/26 or later


Why Euro Latina Finance?

  • You will be part of a global and multicultural team that is based in three different locations across Latin America and Europe and is led by its founder and CEO
  • Play a key role and contribute to the transformational phase of a growing and recognized M&A advisory firm with a solid pipeline and strong deal flow
  • High exposure to a vast array of sectors, top-notch companies, and deal complexity, in a multi-language and cultural environment
  • Runway to grow in a dynamic, unbureaucratic, challenging, and collaborative environment, with great potential for professional development and career promotions

title: Gerente de Negócios
description:
RESPONSABILIDADES

Realizar a venda dos produtos disponíveis em portifólio de forma ativa, presencial ou remotamente, contribuindo com o atingimento das metas comerciais.


  • Prospectar de forma autônoma e eficiente novos leads para compor pipeline de vendas, de acordo com os targets necessários (porte de cliente e perfil de empresa pré-determinado), de cliente de média e alta complexidade.
  • Realizar reuniões presenciais e online com prospects para identificação de oportunidade e apresentação da solução, com pleno conhecimento de produto e processo de venda.
  • Elaborar propostas comerciais de acordo com as diretrizes de pricing pré estabelecidas e apresentar as propostas aos clientes preferencialmente de forma presencial, quando não houver possibilidade, apresentar em reunião online.
  • Na ocasião de fechamento de proposta, acompanhar todo processo de análise documental e trâmite contratual, garantindo que a venda seja finalizada de forma adequada e dentro dos processos de Compliance.
  • Durante todo o processo de venda, desde a prospecção até o fechamento, manter o CRM atualizado, constando todas as informações sobre o lead, contatos, dados cadastrais da empresa, produto ofertado, tamanho da oportunidade, visitas realizadas, documentação de proposta, contrato e todos os anexos enviados pelo cliente devidamente armazenados.
  • No caso de não fechamento da proposta, informar o motivo da perda da oportunidade de forma detalhada.
  • Após assinatura do contrato, realizar acompanhamento do cliente junto às áreas de implementação e ativação, garantindo que os termos combinados no momento da venda sejam cumpridos por ambas as partes.
  • Acompanhar o cliente em estabilização durante o período de 6 meses após implementação, com o apoio da área responsável.
  • Criação de Pipeline: o primeiro desafio para quem inicia na posição é a criação de um pipeline robusto, para isso é importante que a pessoa tenha conhecimento prévio do mercado de cartões corporativos ou plataformas de viagens corporativas, que tenha um bom networking com esse mercado ou que tenha carteira de clientes de médio e grande porte para iniciar prospecção.
  • Contato com interlocutores: O segundo desafio da posição é conseguir contato com interlocutores corretos, após mapear e criar um pipeline, para haver sucesso na evolução das etapas do funil de vendas é importante que a pessoa consiga identificar decisores e para isso é importante que ela tenha perfil Hunter e que tenha experiência prévia com prospecção, cold call, estratégias de SDR.
  • Evolução para proposta: O terceiro maior desafio é conseguir identificar as dores do cliente, transformar em oportunidade e conseguir transmitir ao lead a mensagem principal de que o produto do portifólio de vendas é realmente o que ele necessita para solução daquela dor apresentada, podendo assim, evoluir para uma apresentação de proposta comercial eficiente e com valor agregado. Importante que a pessoa tenha conhecimento de técnicas de vendas como SPIN ou equivalentes e que tenha um perfil consultivo..


REQUISITOS

  • Formação universitária completa em Administração, Finanças, Marketing, Vendas ou correlatas. Desejável pós graduação ou MBA em andamento;
  • Inglês;
  • Vasta experiência na área comercial, com vendas B2B complexas e consultivas, no mercado de Viagens corporativas ou Cartões Corporativos;
  • Experiência em grandes contas;
  • Perfil consultivo e Hunter, com experiencia previa de construção de pipeline, mapeamento de mercado.

title: Keeta-Sales Efficiency Operation Manager (SAKA)
description:
About US：

Keeta is an independent brand of Meituan, the world's largest tech-driven retail company. We focus on food and consumer product delivery services in international markets with the mission: "We help people eat better, live better".

Established in March 2010, Meituan has helped transform the supply and demand of service and product retail across the digital landscape.

As Meituan and Keeta continue to increase R&D investment and advance in new technologies, we uphold a customer-centric approach, working with our partners to provide quality services to customers.


What You'll Do:

  1. Sales Process Optimization: Familiarize with the entire "find-interview-sign-onboard-operate" process and operational pain points of the franchise brand team BD, and establish standardized operational processes to enhance team efficiency.
  2. Sales Tool Development: Identify key points that constrain the improvement of sales productivity, and drive the product and research teams to build and implement sales tools.
  3. Merchant Tool Development: Identify merchant needs and pain points, and promote optimization of merchant-side product capabilities to enhance online operational efficiency for merchants.
  4. Project Management: Use project management methods to ensure effective execution of key business processes and product capabilities. Fully mobilize resources from strategy, product, and operation team to drive the franchise brand team in achieving business objectives.


What We Need From You:

title: Desenvolvedor de back end Node.js
description:
Estamos em busca de uma Pessoa Desenvolvedora Back-end Node.js- Sênior.

Procuramos alguém com perfil colaborativo, boa comunicação e habilidade para se adaptar a diferentes desafios técnicos e organizacionais. Você será uma peça chave no desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades, garantindo qualidade e eficiência, além de colaborar com a equipe na definição de boas práticas de desenvolvimento. Se você curte diversão, energia, alegria, desafios criativos e é uma pessoa organizada, resolutiva, detalhista e orientada a resultados, vem com a gente!

Você será uma peça chave no desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades, garantindo qualidade e eficiência, além de colaborar com a equipe na definição de boas práticas de desenvolvimento.



Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações back-end em Node.js, seguindo boas práticas de arquitetura e padrões de projeto.
  • Criar, documentar e integrar APIs RESTful de alta performance utilizando TypeScript e Express.
  • Projetar e otimizar modelagem de dados em bancos relacionais (MySQL, PostgreSQL) e/ou NoSQL (MongoDB), garantindo queries performáticas e escalabilidade.
  • Utilizar ORMs como TypeORM, Sequelize ou Prisma para manipulação eficiente do banco de dados.
  • Versionar código com Git, adotando workflows (GitFlow, pull requests, code reviews) e boas práticas de controle de versão.
  • Trabalhar com Docker e docker-compose para criar ambientes de desenvolvimento e produção consistentes e reproduzíveis.
  • Garantir qualidade de código por meio de testes automatizados (unitários e de integração) usando Jest, Mocha ou similares.
  • Implementar mecanismos de cache (Redis, Memcached) e filas de mensagens (RabbitMQ, AWS SQS/SNS, Kafka) para melhorar performance e escalabilidade.
  • Monitorar e depurar aplicações em produção utilizando ferramentas como Node Profiler, Datadog, New Relic ou Prometheus.
  • Implementar pipelines de CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins) para deploy automatizado em AWS (ECS, Lambda, RDS, S3) ou Kubernetes.
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares (front-end, DevOps, QA) em metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban), participando de planning, daily e retrospectivas.


Resquisitos:

  • Experiência sólida com Node.js e TypeScript, aplicando padrões de projeto (Factory, Repository, Dependency Injection) e estruturação modular (Clean Architecture, DDD).
  • Uso de Express (ou NestJS/Koa) para construção de APIs, dominando rotas, middlewares, tratamento de erros e validação de payload (class-validator, Joi, Celebrate).
  • Gerenciamento de pacotes com npm ou yarn, versionamento semântico (semver) e controle de dependências.
  • Testes Automatizados: domínio de frameworks como Jest ou Mocha + Chai, testes de integração (supertest) e uso de mocks/fakes.
  • Escalabilidade e Desempenho: experiência em cache (Redis), filas de mensagens (RabbitMQ, Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS) e otimizações de consultas em bancos relacionais (índices, partições).
  • Performance e Debugging: uso de ferramentas como Node Profiler, Clinic.js, monitoramento com Datadog, New Relic ou Prometheus/Grafana.
  • Integração Contínua e Deploy: prática com CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins) e deploy em AWS (ECS, Lambda, RDS, S3) ou ambientes Kubernetes.
  • Docker Avançado: criação de imagens otimizadas, multi-stage builds e configuração de docker-compose para desenvolvimento e produção.
  • Banco de Dados Relacional Avançado: MySQL ou PostgreSQL (índices, query profiling, replicação, particionamento).
  • APIs Performáticas e Seguras: experiência com GraphQL (Apollo Server), API Gateway, autenticação/autorização via OAuth2, JWT e versionamento de APIs.
  • Git Profundo: workflows GitFlow, rebase vs merge, cherry-pick e estratégias de branching para times grandes.


Habilidades:


  • Conhecimento em PHP (Laravel, CodeIgniter, Symfony): será considerado um diferencial entender boas práticas de desenvolvimento back-end em PHP e migrar/integrações pontuais.
  • Experiência com React (ou Next.js): habilidade para colaborar com o front-end em aplicações isomórficas ou SPA, integrando APIs e estados globais (Redux, Context API).
  • Frameworks Node.js avançados: NestJS (dependency injection, modules, providers), Koa ou Fastify para cenários de alta concorrência.
  • Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): conhecimento em Terraform ou CloudFormation para provisionamento de ambientes AWS.
  • Monitoramento e Observabilidade: uso de ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana), Loki/Grafana, OpenTelemetry para logs estruturados e métricas customizadas.
  • Event-Driven Architecture: trabalho com Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS SNS/SQS, WebSockets (Socket.io) e arquiteturas orientadas a eventos.
  • Microservices: experiência em decomposição de sistemas monolíticos, deploy independente de serviços, comunicação via mensageria e API Gateway.
  • Segurança: implementação de práticas OWASP (mitigação de SQL Injection, XSS, CSRF), configuração de WAF (Cloudflare, AWS WAF) e auditoria de código.
  • Serverless: desenvolvimento e deploy de funções AWS Lambda em Node.js/TypeScript, integração com DynamoDB, S3 e triggers (SQS, API Gateway).



Benefícios:

  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição via cartão Ifood Benefícios.

  • Espaço de descompressão #DESLIGUER.
  • Frutas todos os dias
  • Estacionamento.
  • Treinamentos constantes e oportunidades de desenvolvimento.

title: Senior Business Analyst I (L4)
description:
What is Teachable ?


Teachable is trusted by creator-educators around the world to grow their impact and income. From online courses and communities to memberships and downloads, Teachable's digital learning products help creator-educators drive meaningful connection and sustainable revenue. With industry-best ecommerce tools, easily toggled on directly within the platform, creators can confidently maximize their earnings, while getting paid directly by their audience. Teachable's unmatched focus on the student learning experience also ensures creators can make a positive and influential impact on their communities—entirely on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creator-educators use Teachable to share their knowledge, reaching millions of students around the world. To learn more, visit teachable.com.


Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!


About your Team

Growth Marketing at Teachable focuses on bringing more creators to our platform by optimizing each step of the growth funnel. We work closely with Product, Partnerships and Brand & Content, in a fast-paced, results-driven environment. We embrace testing new hypotheses, fail fast and quickly apply those learnings through a very data-driven approach. We're always adapting as both our company and industry continue to evolve, while keeping the ultimate goal of connecting with and supporting creators.


What is the role?

We are looking for a strategic and data-driven Business Analyst to join our Marketing Analytics team. In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for translating complex marketing and business data into actionable insights that drive our growth strategy. You will leverage your structured problem-solving approach and analytical mindset to partner within the Growth, Brand, Partnerships, Product, Data and Finance teams to develop and implement measurement frameworks, analyze performance. You will identify strategic opportunities for optimization which you’re likely to lead or advise all the way through implementation.

This position reports to the Marketing Analytics Lead and plays a crucial role in fostering a data-driven decision-making culture throughout the organization.


This position is hybrid to our São Paulo office. Although flexible, local employees tend to use our São Paulo office 1-2 times a week.


Additionally, this position will collaborate with American employees on a daily basis, so fluency in English is required.


In this role you'll:

  • Build and maintain impactful marketing dashboards using Sigma, Google Analytics, Heap, and Looker that drive business decisions
  • Analyze marketing campaigns across channels to optimize performance and allocation of resources
  • Define and track key metrics (LTV, CAC, Churn, Retention, Conversion Rates) to evaluate business health
  • Design and analyze A/B tests to optimize conversion funnels and marketing effectiveness
  • Own weekly reporting processes to deliver insights to stakeholders, including executive leadership
  • Help develop and improve attribution models to better understand marketing ROI and customer journeys
  • Apply structured problem-solving to complex challenges and develop data-driven solutions
  • Identify growth opportunities through trend analysis and funnel optimization
  • Collaborate with Data Engineers to ensure quality data collection and integration
  • Translate analysis into clear, actionable recommendations with implementation roadmaps


What you'll bring:

  • 2-3 years in business analysis in strategic consulting roles or 3 + years of experience within data analytics and/or data science.
  • Previous Marketing Analytics experience is a plus.
  • Deep understanding of key business metrics: LTV, CAC, Churn, Retention, and Conversion Funnel metrics
  • Knowledge of digital marketing metrics, attribution models, and customer acquisition economics
  • Experience designing and analyzing A/B tests and experiments with statistical rigor
  • Ability to structure complex problems and drive data-driven decision making
  • Excellent communication skills to translate data findings for diverse audiences
  • Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets for data modeling and analysis
  • SQL proficiency and experience with BI tools like Sigma and Power BI
  • Familiarity with Google Analytics, Heap, or similar web analytics platforms
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, Economics, or related fields


Nice to have:

  • Experience with Python or R for data analysis and statistical modeling
  • Understanding (and willing to learn!) on how to leverage AI implementation in analytics and operations workflows
  • Interest in the creator economy landscape and digital education platforms
  • Experience with marketing automation platforms like Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud
  • Background in SaaS or subscription-based business models


Additional details:

At Teachable, we are committed to providing fair and competitive pay (using market data to inform our pay bands), rewarding high performance, and ensuring all employees have the opportunity and ability to impact Teachable’s overall company value. Base salaries will be reviewed at regular intervals throughout the year, typically following performance review cycles currently conducted bi-annually or in conjunction with a promotion.

While Teachable maintains our NY office for local employees to use, we operate as a remote-first culture in order to give our employees added flexibility. In order to maintain connection and create a community beyond the screen, Teachable holds in-person events throughout the year, where employees and teams can come together for bonding, strategic alignment, goal-setting, and celebrations! Teachable encourages individuals from a broad diversity of backgrounds to apply for positions. We are an equal opportunity employer, meaning we're committed to a fair and consistent interview process. Please tell us in your application if you require an accommodation to apply for a job or to perform your job.

title: Social Media Producer
description:
*Vaga para Social Media*


Estamos em busca de uma Social Media proativa, executora e criativa, com olhar apurado para captação de conteúdo e atenção aos detalhes, para atuar no dia a dia da nossa loja.


✅ O que você vai fazer:

• Gravar vídeos do dia a dia com o celular (stories, bastidores, conteúdos leves e espontâneos)

• Garantir que o cenário esteja sempre impecável (sem sujeiras, distrações ou aparelhos mal posicionados)

• Trabalhar em dupla com outra Social Media que já grava bem, ajudando a orientar e incentivar as gravações

• Criar ideias de conteúdos para stories e Reels de forma constante

• Ajudar na criação de campanhas (como Black Friday, Natal, etc.)

• Cumprir metas de conteúdo semanal, como gravações e postagens no feed

• Manter o planejamento e organização das demandas (seguindo prazos e cronograma)


⚠️ O que a gente NÃO quer:

• Alguém que só execute quando for cobrada

• Falta de atenção nos detalhes visuais (aparelho mal limpo, cenário desorganizado, iluminação ruim)

• Postagens e gravações feitas de qualquer jeito ou na correria

• Falta de iniciativa e comprometimento com entregas e metas


Perfil ideal:

• Proatividade: não espera ordens para agir. Viu uma oportunidade de gravação? Vai lá e faz.

• Visão estética: sabe o que é um cenário bonito, limpo, iluminado, com bom ângulo.

• Criatividade: traz ideias diferentes para conteúdos do dia a dia e campanhas pontuais.

• Organização: cumpre prazos, ajuda a planejar o conteúdo com antecedência.

• Boa convivência: vai trabalhar em parceria com outra Social Media, então precisa somar.

• Mão na massa: queremos quem coloca a mão na câmera, na edição e na entrega.


Importante:


Você não vai fazer vídeos de campanha com câmera profissional – isso já temos com um filmmaker. Mas precisa saber gravar com o celular, editar vídeos simples e entregar conteúdo com constância e qualidade.

title: Project Manager

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

  • Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Mais Mulheres Lideres na Odebrecht
description:
Olá, nós somos a Odebrecht Engenharia & Construção . Fazemos parte do Novonor e atuamos, principalmente, no Brasil, Angola e Estados Unidos.

Temos 80 anos de história e nosso propósito é contribuir para a construção de um futuro sustentável, servindo à sociedade por meio da capacidade transformadora de nossa Engenharia. Todos os dias, buscamos fornecer soluções para alguns dos maiores desafios do mundo - como educação, saúde, energia, água, transporte, habitação e saneamento.



Odebrecht & Equidade de Gênero:


A Odebrecht Engenharia & Construção está comprometida em promover a diversidade e a equidade de gênero nas diversas posições de liderança em suas obras ou nas estruturas corporativas. Reconhecemos o valor único que as mulheres trazem para a Engenharia e estamos empenhadas/os em tornar o setor de Construção mais diverso e plural.

Se você é mulher e já atua, ou está próxima a atuar, em cargos de Liderança, oferecemos a oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos desafiadores e que transformam vidas.



Mais Mulheres Líderes na Odebrecht Engenharia & Construção:


Este é um banco de vagas que busca atrair candidaturas para a inclusão de profissionais mulheres em posição de Liderança (Coordenadoras, Gerentes e Diretoras).

A Odebrecht está feliz em contar com sua a candidatura, considerando estas principais áreas de atuação:


  • Mulheres apaixonadas por Produção que executam, gerenciam e supervisionam construções de infraestrutura civil, eletromecânica e industrial;
  • Mulheres que “respiram” Engenharia , com foco nas áreas de planejamento, desenvolvimento de projetos, qualidade, e que contribuem para construção de empreendimentos únicos e que agreguem valor à sociedade;
  • Mulheres da área Comercial / Administração Contratual , que atuam nos escopos de orçamento, acompanhamento de custo, subcontratação, medições etc., zelando pela saúde financeira dos projetos;
  • Mulheres com espírito de servir para atuação nas áreas Administrativa e Financeira , contemplando oportunidades em finanças, recursos humanos, suprimentos, comunicação, responsabilidade social, tecnologia da informação etc.;
  • Mulheres que vivem a Sustentabilidade , atuando nas áreas de Segurança do Trabalho, Responsabilidade Social, Ambiental e Saúde, comprometidas com o desenvolvimento das comunidades onde atuamos, com a integridade física de nossos integrantes e respeitando o meio ambiente.


Nossos processos seletivos estão acontecendo de forma remota e nós encorajamos inscrições de qualquer lugar do Brasil e do mundo.

A inscrição nesse banco de talentos não garante a contratação, pois ela dependerá da disponibilidade de vagas, avaliação de currículos e requisitos de cada uma das oportunidades.



Experiência Odebrecht Engenharia & Construção:


Aqui, acreditamos que o aprendizado acontece de múltiplas formas, oferecendo às nossas Integrantes a oportunidade de participar de programas de Formação de Líderes, Mentoria exclusiva para Mulheres, workshops técnicos e muito mais.

Na Odebrecht, investimos para proporcionar um pacote de benefícios e de políticas internas para você e sua família, que contempla:


  • Plano de Saúde, extensivo a dependentes;
  • Plano Odontológico, extensivo a dependentes;
  • Previdência Privada Vexty, com coparticipação empresarial;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Ações de incentivo ao bem-estar, e;
  • Ações de conscientização e fortalecimento da saúde emocional.
